reviews:
Run this SQL exactly as written (do not modify it, do not add LIMIT) and return all rows:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT franchiseID, COUNT(*) AS reviews
  FROM samples.bakehouse.media_customer_reviews
  GROUP BY franchiseID
)
SELECT f.franchiseID AS franchise_id, f.name AS franchise, f.country, r.reviews
FROM samples.bakehouse.sales_franchises AS f
JOIN r ON r.franchiseID = f.franchiseID
ORDER BY r.reviews DESC;

Then save the result as reviews_by_franchise.csv in this dashboard.
